<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Check whether a project snapshot references external resources"}
></Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/project-snapshots/{projectSnapshotKey}/external-resources"}
  context={"endpoint"}
></MethodEndpoint>

Reports whether this project snapshot references resources that live outside the snapshot itself: forms, call activities, business rule tasks, and RPA resources. `false` for each flag means the snapshot does not reference anything of that kind outside itself.

<Heading id={"request"} as={"h2"} className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[
    {
      name: "projectSnapshotKey",
      in: "path",
      required: true,
      description: "The unique key of the project snapshot.",
      schema: {
        description: "System-generated key for a project snapshot.",
        type: "string",
        format: "ProjectSnapshotKey",
        "x-semantic-type": "ProjectSnapshotKey",
        example: "9c2f1b44-1f0e-4a9b-86bb-0d0a4a2c1f77",
        title: "ProjectSnapshotKey",
      },
    },
  ]}
></ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema title={"Body"} body={undefined}></RequestSchema>

<StatusCodes
  id={undefined}
  label={undefined}
  responses={{
    "200": {
      description: "The external resource report was returned successfully.",
      content: {
        "application/json": {
          schema: {
            type: "object",
            description:
              "Whether a project snapshot references resources outside the snapshot itself. Each flag is independent. All four `false` means no external reference was detected.\n",
            example: {
              hasRefToExternalForms: false,
              hasRefToExternalCallActivities: true,
              hasRefToExternalBusinessRuleTasks: false,
              hasRefToExternalRpaResources: false,
            },
            required: [
              "hasRefToExternalForms",
              "hasRefToExternalCallActivities",
              "hasRefToExternalBusinessRuleTasks",
              "hasRefToExternalRpaResources",
            ],
            properties: {
              hasRefToExternalForms: {
                description:
                  "Whether a BPMN process in the snapshot references a form that is not defined within the snapshot itself, whether or not that form exists anywhere else.\n",
                type: "boolean",
              },
              hasRefToExternalCallActivities: {
                description:
                  "Whether a BPMN process in the snapshot references, via a call activity, a process that is not defined within the snapshot itself, whether or not that process exists anywhere else.\n",
                type: "boolean",
              },
              hasRefToExternalBusinessRuleTasks: {
                description:
                  "Whether a BPMN process in the snapshot references a DMN decision that is not defined within the snapshot itself, whether or not that decision exists anywhere else.\n",
                type: "boolean",
              },
              hasRefToExternalRpaResources: {
                description:
                  "Whether a BPMN process in the snapshot references an RPA resource that is not defined within the snapshot itself, whether or not that resource exists anywhere else.\n",
                type: "boolean",
              },
            },
            title: "ProjectSnapshotExternalResourcesResult",
          },
        },
      },
    },
